1.note: Chat SDK createGroupConversation({ users, channelId: order-<id>, channelData.custom: { orderId, listingId } }); App Context memberships; custom is scalar-only

2.note: card in message meta (SDK); meta is immutable, so the update is a message action of type order_card (same primitive the SDK uses for edits) added by the server; clients fold the latest action into the card via message.onUpdated

3.note: Before Publish Function with our regex mask (pubnub.function.js, pasted into the Admin Portal); Chat SDK message.report lands on PUBNUB_INTERNAL_MODERATION_<channel> (SDK) and is mirrored to our queue. Channel Monitor dashboard and Auto Moderation are paid

4.note: no email, no web push: Events & Actions 'Message sent' webhook + whereNow presence -> Mailpit (needs https PUBLIC_URL and a configured listener)

5.note: no translation: our server provider, translations in meta; PubNub's path would be a Function calling Google/Amazon/Microsoft Translate

6.note: channel.invite(agentUser) (needs manage in the PAM token, granted); getHistory for earlier messages (25 per call, paginated)

7.note: read receipts: membership.setLastReadMessage + onReadReceiptReceived (SDK, stored as membership custom); typing: startTyping/stopTyping/onTypingChanged (SDK, signals); files: MessageDraft.files (SDK, 5 MB)
